capabilities: Sync selected vault folders to GitHub or Forgejo/Gitea repos
Push, pull or sync both ways per folder mapping
Resolve conflicts with mtime checks, 3-way merge and a per-file modal
Rewrite wikilinks, callouts, highlights and math for GitHub rendering
Encrypt file contents end-to-end before upload
disambiguation: Not a general Git client for the vault; it syncs selected folders to a remote repo in a chosen direction.
extras: Token is kept in the OS keychain on Obsidian 1.11.4+ and is per device. Encryption hides file contents only; names, sizes, timing and commit messages stay visible, and losing both passphrase and recovery key makes the remote copy unreadable.
motivation: The author wanted a way to share or back up just one or two vault folders in a repo, since Obsidian's built-in Sync covers the whole vault.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Sync covers the whole vault, so there is no simple way to share or version only one or two folders in a repository.

relations.evidence: turn on Auto-export SVG (or PNG) in the Excalidraw plugin's settings
now also syncs to self-hosted Forgejo / Gitea instances

summary: Plugin that syncs chosen vault folders with GitHub or Forgejo/Gitea repos in one or both directions, with conflict handling and backups.
